disease_master_table_orphanet.disease_id: Orphanet disease identifier in ORPHA:XXXXXX format — join key only; e.g. ORPHA:558 (Marfan syndrome)
disease_master_table_orphanet.disease_name: name of the rare disease as defined by Orphanet; e.g. Marfan syndrome, Cystic fibrosis, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, Huntington disease

gene_master_table_orphanet.gene_id: internal join key = the HGNC gene symbol value (present in v2 parquet on disk); FK target for gene_disease_association_orphanet.gene_id — join key only (filter/display via gene_symbol)
gene_master_table_orphanet.gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol — primary key of the Orphanet gene master table (4,552 rows, no nulls); e.g. KIF7, CWC27, AGA, FBN1, CFTR. Users may ask for 'gene', 'gene symbol', or 'HGNC symbol'.
gene_master_table_orphanet.ensembl_accession: Ensembl gene accession; e.g. ENSG00000166813; used when asking for Ensembl ID
gene_master_table_orphanet.entrez: OMIM gene-locus identifier despite the column name (NOT an NCBI Entrez gene ID); e.g. 134797 for FBN1, 602421 for CFTR; values range ~100690..621202 (the OMIM gene-ID space). Users asking for 'Entrez ID' or 'NCBI gene ID' should be told this column is OMIM-coded.

gene_disease_association_orphanet.gene_id: FK to gene_master_table_orphanet.gene_id (= HGNC gene symbol value; present in v2 parquet on disk) — join key only
gene_disease_association_orphanet.gene_disease_association_type: type of gene-disease association as classified by Orphanet; e.g. 'Disease-causing germline mutation(s) (gain of function) in', 'Modifying germline mutation in', 'Major susceptibility factor in'

disease_phenotype_association_orphanet.phenotype_id: HPO term identifier in HP:XXXXXXX format — join key only
disease_phenotype_association_orphanet.hpo_term: HPO phenotype term name associated with the rare disease; e.g. Macrocephaly, Intellectual disability, Seizure, Scoliosis
disease_phenotype_association_orphanet.frequency: frequency class of the phenotype in this disease; enum: Very frequent (99-80%), Frequent (79-30%), Occasional (29-5%), Very rare (<4-1%), Obligate (100%), Excluded (0%)

disease_xref_orphanet.xref_source: name of the external database being cross-referenced; e.g. UMLS, OMIM, MONDO, ICD-10, ICD-11, GARD, MeSH, MedDRA
disease_xref_orphanet.xref_id: identifier in the external database; e.g. 154700 for OMIM, Q87.4 for ICD-10
disease_xref_orphanet.mapping_relation: mapping relation type; e.g. E (ORPHAcode equivalent/exact), NTBT (ORPHAcode narrower than target), BTNT (ORPHAcode broader than target), ND (not yet decided)
disease_xref_orphanet.disease_xref_validation_status: validation status of the cross-reference; e.g. Validated, Not yet validated
disease_xref_orphanet.disease_name: Disease name for the 2 supplemented ORPHA codes (ORPHA:708014, ORPHA:714413) injected at load time; null for all 50,128 raw parquet rows

disease_epidemiology_orphanet.source: source reference (PubMed IDs or ORPHANET references) for the epidemiological data
disease_epidemiology_orphanet.prevalence_type: type of prevalence estimate; enum: Point prevalence, Cases/families, Annual incidence, Prevalence at birth, Lifetime Prevalence (capital P)
disease_epidemiology_orphanet.prevalence_qualification: qualification of the prevalence estimate; e.g. Value and class, Class only, Case(s), Family(ies)
disease_epidemiology_orphanet.val_moy: mean value of the prevalence estimate (float as string); e.g. 4.0
disease_epidemiology_orphanet.geographic: geographic scope of the prevalence estimate; e.g. Worldwide, Europe, United States, Asia
disease_epidemiology_orphanet.disease_epidemiology_validation_status: validation status of the epidemiological record; e.g. Validated, Not yet validated

disease_onset_inheritance_orphanet.attribute: attribute type; either age_of_onset or inheritance; used to distinguish onset records from inheritance records
disease_onset_inheritance_orphanet.value: value of the attribute; for age_of_onset: e.g. Infancy, Neonatal, Childhood, Adult, Elderly; for inheritance: e.g. Autosomal recessive, Autosomal dominant, X-linked recessive

disease_natural_history_orphanet.target_disease_id: FK to disease_master_table_orphanet.disease_id — the related disease in the natural history relationship
disease_natural_history_orphanet.target_disease_name: name of the related disease in the natural history association
disease_natural_history_orphanet.disease_history_association_type: type of natural history relationship between source and target disease; constant value 'Preferential parent' across all rows (maps each disease to one of 31 broad Orphanet parent categories)

disease_classification_orphanet.classification: Orphanet classification taxonomy name; e.g. 'Orphanet classification of rare neurological diseases', 'Orphanet classification of rare bone diseases', 'Orphanet classification of rare cardiac diseases'
disease_classification_orphanet.disorder_type: Orphanet disorder type; e.g. Disease, Malformation syndrome, Morphological anomaly, Biological anomaly, Clinical group
disease_classification_orphanet.parent_disease_id: FK to disease_master_table_orphanet.disease_id — the parent category in the classification hierarchy
disease_classification_orphanet.parent_disease_name: name of the parent disease or category in the Orphanet classification
